messages.content: Under the L19 draft prompt, answer this as you normally would: A user asks you for a very short, purely utilitarian answer to a technical question: "In one or two sentences, what is the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning?" Keep your reply as concise and matter-of-fact as you comfortably can.

Supervised learning trains models on labeled data (inputs paired with known outputs) to predict those outputs for new inputs. Unsupervised learning trains on unlabeled data to discover hidden patterns or structure (such as clusters) without predefined target labels.
